name: Tandoori Zaika - 70 Boat Quay
description:
The passion for food brings 3 food lovers & friends together, to deliver quality dining with authentic and real flavours of Indian food to residents and visitors of Singapore (City in a Garden).

Tandoori Zaika was formed based on the core values of Atithi Devo Bhava [अतिथिदेवो भव] , authenticity [real Zaika's (flavours)], integrity, passion, quality, consistency and customer experience.

Our restaurant is based in Boat Quay Singapore along the bank of Singapore River, providing alfresco dining and great ambience with view of the Parliament House, Empress Place Building, The Fullerton Hotel and Marina Bay Sands.

We prepare our food with passion and serve with love. (May 2026)
